EC2: - Other indications for the use of diuretics.
EC3: - Intolerance [OR] or contraindications to the study drugs.
EC4: - Cardiovascular disease (heart failure, [OR] myocardial infarction [OR] or stroke).
EC6: - Chronic kidney disease [OR] and / or abnormal renal function (creatinine >1.5 mg/dL).
EC9: - Previous antihypertensive treatment with more than one drug.
EC10: - Systolic blood pressure ≥160 mmHg [OR] or diastolic blood pressure ≥100 mmHg measured through office blood pressure.
EC11: - Pregnancy [OR] or prospective pregnancy during the study.
